content.title: About
content.content: Flour 00 is a high‑quality, finely milled wheat flour of the highest grade. It has an extremely fine texture, low gluten content and a bright white color, making it ideal for delicate baked goods such as sponge cakes, pastries and pizza crusts.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Flour 00 is traditionally used in Italian cuisine for pasta and pizza dough.
The “00” designation refers to the fineness of the grind – the higher the number, the finer the flour.
Unlike whole‑grain flours, 00 flour contains no bran or germ, giving it a longer shelf life.
It is favored by pastry chefs for creating light, airy textures in cakes and biscuits.
In some countries 00 flour is considered a “professional” grade and is sold mainly in specialty stores.

items.title: Source of carbohydrates
items.content: Provides a quick source of energy through easily digestible carbs.

items.title: Low gluten content
items.content: Suitable for people who need moderate gluten intake.

items.title: Rich in B‑vitamins
items.content: Contains thiamine, niacin and folate, which support metabolism and nervous system function.

items.title: Contains minerals
items.content: Provides small amounts of iron, magnesium and phosphorus important for bones and blood.

items.title: Easy to digest
items.content: The fine grind aids digestion compared with coarser flours.

items.title: Gluten
items.content: Contains gluten, so it is unsuitable for people with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: High glycemic index
items.content: Large portions can cause a rapid rise in blood sugar.

items.title: Loss of nutrients
items.content: Removal of bran and germ reduces fiber and some micronutrients.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: May trigger allergic reactions in individuals sensitive to wheat.

content.title: How to Use
content.content: Flour 00 is used for pizza dough, pasta, sponge cakes, cupcakes, cookies and thin laminated pastries. When mixing dough, it is recommended to sift the flour to avoid lumps and add a pinch of salt and sugar to enhance flavor.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store 00 flour in an airtight container in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. For long‑term storage keep it in the refrigerator or freezer to prevent mold growth and oil rancidity.
